tools.name: get_horoscope
tools.description: A sign's daily horoscope: theme, reading, its sky, ratings -2..+2. Example: sign='Leo', lang='en'.

tools.name: get_day
tools.description: A whole day: the Moon's sign, the sky, all twelve signs. Example: date='2026-11-02', lang='es'.

tools.name: get_moon_phases
tools.description: New and full moons to 2030 (default: next 90 days) with sign, eclipse, name. Example: from='2027-01-01', to='2027-03-31'.

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description: Tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana with start and end (IST, Lahiri), within a year. Example: date='2026-11-08'.

tools.name: get_solar_terms
tools.description: A year's 24 solar terms (2025-2031): UTC moment, hanzi, pinyin, names. Example: year=2027, lang='pt'.

tools.name: get_maya_day
tools.description: Cholq'ij day: number, nawal, Long Count (GMT 584283); meanings come from an ajq'ij. Example: date='1990-05-12'.

tools.name: get_islamic_dates
tools.description: Expected Ramadan and Eid dates 2027-2028 by the main calendars; communities may differ by a day. Example: no arguments.

tools.name: list_days
tools.description: Every day with a published horoscope, newest last. Example: lang='pt'.
